task.title: Reconcile CI Job Topology for Probes and Evidence

metrics.coverageNote: This task changes CI topology and package scripts; coverage was not re-measured, so null is reported rather than a fabricated percentage.

tdd.red: scripts/verification/ci-probe-topology.test.ts was written before the workflow/package changes and produced 0 pass, 7 fail. Failures named the missing workflow_dispatch input, eap-probes job, scripts, ledger delta, blocking suite link, and signal declarations.
tdd.green: The topology test passed 7/7 after the minimal workflow and package-script implementation. Final proportional run with entrypoint regression coverage passed 16/16 with 62 expect() calls.
tdd.refactor: Every job now carries one machine-checked BLOCKING SIGNAL or ADVISORY SIGNAL comment. Manual dispatch is isolated from push/PR jobs, and all probe/evidence steps after the first use always() so one advisory failure cannot hide later evidence.

acceptance.criterion: An eap-probes job runs concurrency, cancellation, and scale probes on its own trigger with continue-on-error true and uploads the Benchmark Ledger delta
acceptance.evidence: workflow_dispatch exposes the opt-in boolean run_eap_probes. Only eap-probes is eligible on that event, it declares continue-on-error: true, runs the three package scripts sequentially with EAP_BENCHMARK_RECORD=1, materializes .verification/run/benchmark-ledger.delta.patch plus the resulting ledger, and uploads the directory with actions/upload-artifact@v4 even after failure.

acceptance.criterion: Deterministic correctness assertions still run in the blocking suite, separate from advisory timing measurements
acceptance.evidence: The blocking test job still invokes root bun run test. packages/mcp-server exposes test:probes:deterministic naming concurrency-probe.test.ts, cancellation-probe.test.ts, cancellation-duplicate-effect.test.ts, and scale-probe.test.ts; the advisory job invokes only the executable probe entrypoints.

acceptance.criterion: Every CI job explicitly states whether it blocks and on which signal
acceptance.evidence: A structural test enumerates test, typecheck, client-node, e2e, coverage, load, and eap-probes and requires exactly one governed BLOCKING SIGNAL or ADVISORY SIGNAL declaration in every job block.

verification.benchmarkLedger: PASS - 41 records, 39 samples, one band, chain intact, no breach
verification.combinedProbeSuite: INCONCLUSIVE - a combined escalated command was externally interrupted after approximately 9.6 minutes. No pass is claimed from it; no subprocess created by that command remained afterward.
verification.proportionality: Task 20 changes static CI orchestration only. The executable probes were already individually evidenced by tasks 17-19; task 20 verifies command reachability and topology without rerunning the seven-minute 100k fixture.

decisions: The dedicated trigger is manual workflow_dispatch with an explicit boolean. No schedule or cadence was invented because the specification leaves cadence undecided.
Push/PR jobs explicitly exclude workflow_dispatch, so the manual probe trigger does not accidentally run the blocking pipeline; eap-probes is excluded from push/PR.
The three probe commands are separate serial steps. Cancellation produces deterministic evidence but no Benchmark Ledger sample; concurrency and scale append under EAP_BENCHMARK_RECORD=1.
The artifact contains only the ledger delta patch and resulting ledger, not tenant fixtures. This avoids choosing the unresolved fixture-redaction policy.

scopeNotes.verificationRun: .verification/run is intentionally ignored transient output. CI creates it, writes the ledger delta and resulting ledger, uploads it, and does not commit it.
scopeNotes.projectMemory: No docs/.digest.md, docs/.graph.json, docs/README.md, or docs/feature edit was made. Task 21 owns derived documentation reconciliation and was not started.
scopeNotes.preservedTask19: All task-19 source, tests, and append-only ledger records were preserved.
